controles.affirmation: Le 27 juillet 2025 Cadence a plaide coupable d'un chef de conspiration en vue de violer les controles a l'export, avec probation de trois ans, programmes de conformite, obligations de rapport, certification, evaluation des risques et cooperation aux enquetes futures
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2025 : "on July 27, 2025, we reached a settlement with each of BIS and the U.S. Department of Justice ('DOJ')" ; "we entered into a plea agreement with the DOJ pursuant to which we agreed to plead guilty to one count of conspiracy to commit export controls violations. The plea agreement has a three-year probationary term and includes obligations to implement additional export compliance programs and policies, including ongoing reporting and certification requirements and risk assessments, as well as obligations to cooperate in any ongoing or future investigations"

controles.affirmation: Faits : ventes de 45,3 M$ entre 2015 et 2021 par une filiale a un client en Chine, puis transfert de la technologie a un tiers en Chine sans autorisation
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2025 : "export control violations that occurred between 2015 and 2021 primarily involving sales initiated by a Cadence subsidiary of products and services valued at $45.3 million in total over that period to a customer in China, as well as the subsequent transfer of technology involved in those sales to a third party in China, without the requisite authorization from BIS"

controles.affirmation: Le respect de l'accord administratif BIS est une condition du maintien de la capacite d'exporter ; deux audits internes annuels du programme de conformite
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2025 : "Obligations under the administrative settlement agreement include two internal annual audits of our export compliance programs. Compliance with the administrative settlement agreement is a condition to our continued ability to export products."

controles.affirmation: Penalites et confiscations nettes 140,6 M$ payees au T3 2025, apres charge de 128,5 M$ en compte de resultat
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2025 : "we paid BIS and the DOJ aggregate net penalties and forfeitures of $140.6 million during the three months ended September 30, 2025" ; "we recorded a charge of $128.5 million in Loss related to contingent liability". Recoupement 10-Q T2 2026 : resultat operationnel T2 2025 publie 241,8 M$ ; retraite de 128,5 M$ = 370,3 M$ sur 1 275,4 M$ = 29,0%.

controles.affirmation: Le 23 mai 2025 le BIS a impose une licence pour l'export des logiciels EDA vers la Chine ; levee le 2 juillet 2025 ; le CA en Chine a baisse pendant cette periode
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2025 : "on May 23, 2025, BIS informed us that a license was required for the export, re-export or in-country transfer of EDA Software and Technology when a party to the transaction is located in China..." ; "On July 2, 2025, BIS informed us that the license requirements set forth in the May 23, 2025 letter from BIS were rescinded effective immediately" ; "During this period, our revenue in China decreased primarily due to reduced deliveries of software offerings to our customers in China due to these license requirements"

controles.affirmation: Regle interimaire BIS du 29 septembre 2025 etendue aux entites detenues a 50% ou plus, suspendue un an le 11 novembre 2025, expiration le 9 novembre 2026 sauf prolongation
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2025 : "effective September 29, 2025, BIS issued an interim final rule that extended the export restrictions ... to entities that are 50% or more owned by one or more of such entities. However, on November 11, 2025, BIS published a one-year suspension of the new rule that is currently set to expire on November 9, 2026, absent a future extension."

controles.affirmation: Incident cyber : un attaquant a obtenu une quantite limitee d'informations confidentielles dont fichiers de test, de configuration et de code source, non significatifs ; aucune interruption ; environnements clients non touches
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "we learned that a threat actor obtained a limited amount of Confidential Information from certain of our IT systems including a limited amount of test files, configuration setting files and source code files which are not material to our business" ; "we have acquired and continue to acquire companies with less sophisticated security measures"

controles.affirmation: Concurrents chinois emergents nommes par Cadence et politique nationale chinoise visant le leadership 2030
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2025 : "emerging players in China such as Huada Empyrean, Xpeedic Technology, X-EPIC, Primarius Technologies, Univista, and Giga Design Automation" ; "China's stated national policy to be a global leader in all segments of the semiconductor industry by 2030" ; "Key competitors include Synopsys, Inc., Ansys, Inc. (acquired by Synopsys), Siemens EDA"

controles.affirmation: SBC 285,1 M$ au S1 2026 pour 702,7 M$ de resultat net (40,6%) et 9,3% du CA ; actions diluees 273,3 M vers 274,9 M (+0,6%)
Remuneration du DG 56 683 576 $ pour 95 689 $ de salarie median, ratio 592 pour 1 ; say-on-pay 89% en 2025, moyenne 93% sur dix ans et 90% sur cinq ans ; aucune modification du programme
controles.verbatim_source: DEF 14A 25/03/2026 : "The median of the annual total compensation of all of Cadence's employees, other than Dr. Devgan, was $95,689" ; "Dr. Devgan's annual total compensation ... was $56,683,576" ; "estimated to be 592 to 1" ; "approximately 89% of votes cast" ; "average level of stockholder support of approximately 93% of the votes cast" ; "approximately 90% of the votes cast ... over the past five years" ; "did not make any changes to the company's executive compensation program in response to the 2025 say-on-pay vote"
controles.correction_proposee: Aucune erreur factuelle. Omission de contexte a considerer : le meme DEF 14A publie une ALTERNATIVE PAY RATIO annualisant les LTP Awards 2022 et 2025, precisement parce que le ratio de 592 est gonfle par la comptabilisation integrale d'un plan pluriannuel l'annee de l'octroi. Mentionner cette contre-mesure de la societe renforcerait la credibilite du bloc.
